name: facet-indexed-list
instr:
Please add indexed list construction to `facet-reflect` in `/app`, so a deserializer can fill a Vec out of order and return to an unfinished element later.

Expose `facet_reflect::Partial::begin_list_item_at(self, index: usize) -> Result<Self, ReflectError>` for both borrowing and owned construction. Like `begin_list_item`, it enters an element that the caller leaves with `end()`, but it requires deferred mode and an initialized `Def::List`. Indices are zero-based positions in the final list, including any values already present. Addressing a new position reserves all positions through that index; `finish_deferred()` must reject unvisited positions rather than fill them with defaults. The final list is in index order, not arrival order.

Returning to a position resumes its construction state, including unfinished nested values. Setting that element again replaces its value. Indexed construction must work with the existing field, container and wrapper construction APIs. Treat each indexed position as the root of a deferred subtree: re-entering through `begin_some()` or `begin_smart_ptr()` must restore the saved inner frame rather than allocate a new one. Whole-element `set(...)` must instead discard that position's saved descendants and release their initialized resources, so stale partial frames cannot overwrite or invalidate the replacement.
